## Change

Describe one coherent proposed change and the exact version it succeeds.

## Load-bearing function

What function is preserved, narrowed, replaced, or deleted?

## Evidence

Provide counterexamples, behavioral checks, negative controls, and limitations.

## Provenance checklist

- [ ] I marked modifications and preserved the source version.
- [ ] I have authority to license my contribution under CC BY 4.0.
- [ ] I included no private, proprietary, or personal material.
- [ ] I considered the strongest objection to my proposal.
- [ ] I preserved released tags and snapshots and propose changes for a new publication version.
